The '''Seville family compound''' was the headquarters of the [[Seville Family|Seville pirate clan]] in the times of matriarch [[Darion Seville]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[MdZ-BLK]] loaded a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] with [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] and sent it to crash against the Seville family compound.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
